page.layout: One printed page: a calendar table for December in the centre, with a centred month heading above it. Columns: Aurei num. | Dies mensis | Litera | festival name | Dies collecti in anno communi | Dies collecti in anno bissextili. Running head at top centre, page number top left. Small mark at the foot right.

page.notes: Table cells are separated by " | ". The bissextili value for day 14 is printed as "3.9" (probably 349, with a printing blot). Small marks in the middle of the table and the mark at the foot centre are stains or scan artefacts and are not transcribed. The mark at the foot right "Di" is treated as a catchword. The Google digitiser credit is omitted.
